cases.text: I am buzzing to see the finished stage tonight.
Sobrang ganado akong pumunta sa event mamaya.
I am waiting for next month's announcement with quiet expectation.
Abang ako sa resulta ng scholarship sa susunod na linggo.
The list is so long that I freeze before choosing a first task.
Hindi ko ma-process ang dami ng kailangan ngayong araw.
I fear the phone will ring with bad news.
Kinakabahan ako baka bumagsak ang interview.
The printer jams each time I submit the form.
Nakakainis na hindi sumusunod ang code.
Weeks of back-to-back obligations are draining me.
Laging may deadline kaya pagod at pressured ako.
I keep wishing I had apologized sooner for what I said.
Masama ang loob ko sa sarili ko dahil hindi ako tumulong.
I feel exposed whenever I remember that public mistake.
Gusto kong magtago kapag pinag-uusapan nila ang mali ko.
I am eager for the new role, yet I worry I will disappoint everyone.
Overwhelmed ako sa tasks at kinakabahan sa deadline bukas.
I am proud of the result, although I still doubt whether it is good enough.
Masaya ako sa bagong friends pero nami-miss ko pa rin ang bahay.
Maybe it is worry, maybe it is tiredness; I cannot tell yet.
Hindi ko alam kung anong nararamdaman ko tungkol dito.
My roommate is hurting after the news; I am only asking how to support her.
My reaction to the timetable is neutral; I have no particular feeling about it.
